texts.citation: Moshe Gil, Documents of the Jewish Pious Foundations from the Cairo Geniza (Leiden: Brill, 1976).
texts.html:
Column I (right side)

  1. The beginning of the lease of Samuel Kohen, from the first
  2. of the month of Tammuz.
  3. Of it, collected from him
  4. by way of
  5. prepayment, 80.
  6. Palm branches, 8,
  7. half a qīrāṭ. Plus the half owed to him, 8.

Column II (left side)

  1. The darb of the Synagogue ….
  2. The room of Ibrahīm al-....
  3. The wife of Manṣūr, in silver, 40.
  4. Of it, paid to his scribe, in silver, 20. Plus …. 30.
  5. Plus 10; from Iyyar, 5, plus 5, plus 5, plus 5,
  6. plus 5.
  7. Spent for al-Ghazāla, in silver, 28.
  8. Spent qīrāṭs (?), 2.
  9. The balance for nāshūsh and nails, 1. Palm branches, 1. The donkey of ʿUthmān (?), 10.
